test_title: PYST 42: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option (1): HPSY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad148d1e8df357d40719bc26b59d0cc8f48b1532b90ebd748eca6611647e4d84.png] 

**Option (2): YGIP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db0a48495aaf5594226e9f14b213dc5158472302311e1032e057917f76127f2f.png] 

Option (3): AILR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01987d74094d3a8e5f840088e203ee4bda05444a93c212920a8bef3f6252f4e0.png] 

Option (4): NVYE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6935894ec2be11cdf3ec92cef3dab1e8c71eba4c29707ef7cf8efe60e634e180.png] 

The letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to the group is: **YGIP.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (2)"**
